name: Apart Vereina
beschreibung: The Apart Vereina is located in the center of Serfaus at an altitude of approximately 1,400 meters. The accommodation combines cozy apartment accommodations with the amenities of an inn. Guests can expect an uncomplicated, welcoming family atmosphere with a breakfast option and immediate proximity to the mountain cable cars. Serfaus serves as an ideal base for hikes and ski tours in the Tyrolean Oberland. On-site parking spaces are available.
